devdoc.details: V2 remains the canonical lifecycle implementation. V3 adds risk admission, terminal      callbacks, and recovery data for settlement callbacks that fail open.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

cancelIntent(bytes32).details: V3 guards cancellation because it invokes an external risk callback during resolution.

cleanupOrphanedIntents(bytes32[]).details: V3 guards cleanup because it invokes an external risk callback during resolution.

params._chainId: Chain identifier used by existing intent signature validation.
params._relayerRegistry: Existing relayer registry retained for compatibility.
params._riskCallbackGasLimit: Gas forwarded to each risk callback.

fulfillIntent((bytes,bytes32,bytes,bytes.details: This function adds a reentrancy guard as it's calling the post intent hook contract which itself might call  malicious contracts.

params._params: Struct containing all the fulfill intent parameters

getIntentSettlement(bytes32).details: Successful callbacks intentionally leave this record empty.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params._intents: Array of intent hashes to prune

params._intentHash: Hash of intent to resolve by releasing the funds

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._allowMultiple: True to allow all accounts to signal multiple intents, false to restrict to whitelisted relayers only

setDepositPreIntentHook(address,uint256,.details: Callable only by the deposit's depositor or delegate.

setDepositRiskHook(address,uint256,addre.details: Existing intents keep their snapshotted hook.

setDepositWhitelistHook(address,uint256,.details: Callable only by the deposit's depositor or delegate. The whitelist hook is a dedicated slot separate from the generic pre-intent hook, enabling private orderbook functionality without occupying the generic hook slot.

params._params: Struct containing all the intent parameters

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: OrchestratorV3

constructor.notice: Creates a V3 orchestrator while preserving all V2 constructor dependencies.

fulfillIntent((bytes,bytes32,bytes,bytes.notice: Anyone can submit a fulfill intent transaction, even if caller isn't the intent owner. Upon submission the offchain payment proof is verified, payment details are validated, intent is removed, and escrow state is updated. Deposit token is transferred to the intent.to address.

getAccountIntentCount(address).notice: Returns the number of unresolved intents for an account in constant time.

getDepositRiskHook(address,uint256).notice: Returns the risk hook currently selected for future deposit intents.

getIntentRiskHook(bytes32).notice: Returns the immutable hook snapshot for an active intent.

getIntentSettlement(bytes32).notice: Returns recovery data for a settlement callback that failed open.

getRiskIntent(bytes32).notice: Returns the scalar intent fields required by a risk hook without copying dynamic intent data.

pauseOrchestrator().notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Pauses intent creation and fulfillment functionality.  Functionalities that are paused: - Intent creation (signalIntent) - Intent fulfillment (fulfillIntent) Functionalities that remain unpaused to allow users to recover funds: - Intent cancellation (cancelIntent) - Manual fund release by depositor (releaseFundsToPayer) - Intent pruning by escrow (pruneIntents) - All governance functions - All view functions

pruneIntents(bytes32[]).notice: Only the escrow contract owns the intent can call this function. Called by escrow to prune specific expired intents. Escrow leads the cleanup process.

releaseFundsToPayer(bytes32).notice: Allows depositor to release funds to the payer in case of a failed fulfill intent or because of some other arrangement between the two parties. Upon submission we check to make sure the msg.sender is the depositor, the intent is removed, and  escrow state is updated. Deposit token is transferred to the payer.

setAllowMultipleIntents(bool).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Sets whether all accounts can signal multiple intents.

setDepositPreIntentHook(address,uint256,.notice: Sets or removes the pre-intent hook for a specific deposit.

setDepositRiskHook(address,uint256,addre.notice: Sets or removes the risk hook used by future intents for one deposit.

setDepositWhitelistHook(address,uint256,.notice: Sets or removes the whitelist hook for a specific deposit.

setEscrowRegistry(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the escrow registry address.

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the protocol fee. This fee is charged to takers upon a successful fulfillment of an intent.

setProtocolFeeRecipient(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the protocol fee recipient address.

setRelayerRegistry(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Updates the relayer registry address.

setRiskCallbackGasLimit(uint256).notice: Updates gas forwarded to admission and terminal risk callbacks.

signalIntent((address,uint256,uint256,ad.notice: Signals intent to pay the depositor defined in the _depositId the _amount * deposit conversionRate off-chain at  their given _payeeId in order to unlock _amount of funds on-chain. Caller must provide a signature from the deposit's gating service to prove their eligibility to take liquidity. This function captures and stores all values required for fullfilling the intent to give strong guarantees to the buyer. Locks liquidity for the corresponding deposit on the escrow contract.

unpauseOrchestrator().notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Restarts paused functionality for the orchestrator.

userdoc.notice: Extends the V2 intent lifecycle with snapshotted depositor-selected risk callbacks.
